newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China okays Huaneng debt securities issue.
newsitem.headline: China okays Huaneng debt securities issue.

text.p: Chinese power company Huaneng Power International Inc said on Friday it has received approval from Chinese government agencies to issue convertible debt securities of about US$200 million in a public offering.
The debt securities are expected to be offered in the second quarter of 1997, Huaneng said in a statement to Hong Kong media.
The firm intends to use the proceeds of the offering for its installed capacity expansion programmes in China, it said.
The offering is subject to shareholders' approval at a meeting scheduled to be held in April, it said.
Huaneng, an independent power producer, owns and operates power plants in China.
